119a0da3.yl: Yield: 10 × 450 g (250 g broth + 200 g pounded meat) · Portion: 450 g
c: Lamb 1800 g bone-in → cooked meat ≈ 950 g
Soak pulses overnight. Put lamb, pulses, onion, turmeric and water in a pot; skim; simmer 2 h.
Add pierced dried limes, tomatoes, paste and potatoes; simmer 1 h until meat falls off the bone.
Strain: broth (2500 g) served in bowls with torn bread; solids (bone removed) go to the pounded meat.
Pound meat, potatoes and pulses with a little fat to a coarse paste; season.
Serve with bread for the broth, raw red onion, dried mint and torshi.

Wash rice until water runs clear; soak 2 h in salted water.
Parboil in plenty of boiling salted water 6–7 min until al dente outside, firm centre; drain, rinse lukewarm.
Oil and butter the pot base; layer rice in a cone; poke 5 steam holes; drizzle melted butter.
Wrap lid in a cloth (damkesh); 10 min medium, then 45 min very low. Lift 300 g, mix with saffron water for the top.
Advieh (Persian spice blend: rose, cardamom, cinnamon, cumin)
Layer lentils through rice before steaming.
Fry sliced onion slowly 25 min until deep brown; sauté dates and raisins in butter with cinnamon and advieh; top the rice.

Fry thin-sliced onion until deep golden; reserve a third for garnish; cool.

Cut lamb 3.5 cm cubes; marinate in onion juice, yoghurt, oil, lemon and saffron 24 h.
Thread 5 cubes per skewer with onion and pepper chunks; salt; grill 8–10 min turning, core 63–65 °C.
Brush with saffron butter on resting.

Whisk yoghurt smooth; add still water and salt; chill 2 h.
Whisk hard to a froth at service (or top with sparkling water); finish with rubbed dried mint and rose petals.
Boil sugar and water 3 min; cool; add rose water; freeze to -18 °C slush.

Freeze 4 h, scraping with a fork every 30 min until icy strands form.
Scrape into chilled bowls; serve with fresh lime and sour cherry syrup.

Whisk in slurry; cook stirring 10 min until thick and silky; add rose water; pour into glasses; chill 3 h.
Top with ground pistachio and rose petals.
Soak wheat overnight. Simmer lamb with onion and turmeric 2 h until falling apart; shred finely; keep the stock.
Cook wheat in the stock 3 h, stirring, until it breaks down; add meat; beat with a paddle 20 min until stretchy and smooth.
Serve hot with melted butter, sugar and cinnamon (traditional winter breakfast).
